description: This PHP source file is a test class named ClaimDaoAttachmentTest, which contains unit tests for the ClaimDao class related to claim attachment functionalities such as getting, saving, deleting, and retrieving claim attachments within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: ClaimDaoAttachmentTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ClaimDao attachment-related functions, testing retrieval, creation, deletion, and file retrieval of claim attachments.

methods.name: testGetPartialClaimAttachment
methods.description: Tests retrieving a partial claim attachment by its request and attachment ID, asserts the ID and filename.

methods.name: testGetClaimAttachmentCount
methods.description: Tests counting the claim attachments that match a filter parameter requesting attachments with request ID 1, asserting the count is 3.

methods.name: testGetClaimAttachmentList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of claim attachments by filter, asserting the list contains 3 items and the first filename matches expected.

methods.name: testGetNextAttachmentId
methods.description: Tests obtaining the next attachment ID after current highest (4), expecting 4.

methods.name: testSaveClaimAttachment
methods.description: Tests creating a new ClaimAttachment entity, populating its fields, saving it, and verifying its retrieval.

methods.name: testDeleteClaimAttachments
methods.description: Tests deleting claim attachments by IDs and verifying they no longer exist.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment and populates test data from a fixture YAML file.

methods.name: testGetClaimAttachmentFile
methods.description: Tests retrieving claim attachment file data, verifying description, filename, and attachment content, including handling non-existent IDs.
